name: Exec Cluster Cost: FX — Percent Commission + Fixed Slippage
description: Tests: Percent commission (0.002%) + Fixed slippage ($0.0001). Run with --cost fx
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER COST: FX-Style Percent Commission + Fixed Slippage
# Run with: --cost fx --cash 100000
# Validates: percentage-of-trade commission model, fixed dollar slippage
# Uses equity assets as proxy (validates cost model, not asset class)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: EMA crossover ===
fast = ma(period=12, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow = ma(period=26, type=MAType.ema)(close)
is_bull = fast > slow
is_bear = fast < slow
held_long = hold_until()(enter=is_bull, exit=is_bear)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=is_bear, exit=is_bull)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=20)

atr_val = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=atr_val * 2)
